priority: Blocks all further Body-authority expansion, including the founder-requested ChatGPT relay Body/Capsule.
why_this_mission_exists: Founder asked (2026-08-15) for Taloa to gain a ChatGPT Body adapter using real mouse/keyboard/Accessibility control.
Before drafting that adapter, checked whether it's currently allowed under this product's own already-ratified rules.
It isn't: every step of the sealed TALOA-OVERLAY-P1-0001 mission carries 'Do not widen any Body capability or authority — Gate 0 (blueprint §45a) is still open.'

Gate 0 (TALOA_UNIVERSAL_OVERLAY_FLUID_UI_BLUEPRINT_CLAUDE_DRAFT.md:780-792) was agreed jointly by the founder, Claude, and ChatGPT on 2026-08-11 — this sequencing is not new caution invented for this mission.
Live-code-checked against all 7 Gate 0 items on 2026-08-15: 2 closed (DeviceRegistry is a real store via capability-registry-service.js; secret scanners wired into pre-commit), 5 open.

This mission closes 4 of the 5 open items. The 5th (rotate COMMAND_CENTER_KEY) is a live production secret change and is intentionally NOT dispatched to the automatic factory — see manual_action_required below.
scope: GATE0-001: add a real verify() method to the already-built-but-unwired services/taloa/task-authorization-envelope.js.
GATE0-002: wire routes/general-browser-agent-routes.js's vault/payment authority check to that verify() instead of trusting a bare client-supplied founder_authority boolean.
GATE0-003: add per-Body-scoped credentials (issueBodyToken/verifyBodyToken) on top of the existing, already-real overlay_devices DeviceRegistry.
GATE0-004: add nonce+timestamp replay protection to the shared command-key middleware.
non_goals: Do NOT build the ChatGPT Body adapter / Capsule in this mission — that is a separate, already-drafted blueprint (docs/products/universal-overlay/TALOA_CHATGPT_RELAY_AND_CAPSULE_BLUEPRINT_2026-08-15.md) explicitly sequenced to dispatch only after this mission's acceptance passes.
Do NOT rotate COMMAND_CENTER_KEY or any other live secret in this mission — that is manual_action_required below, not an author_then_write step.
Do NOT modify any file not named in BLUEPRINT.json's steps.
Do NOT introduce a new npm dependency.

manual_action_required.action: Rotate COMMAND_CENTER_KEY and the database connection string at the source (Railway env vars + local .env), per Gate 0 item 1.
manual_action_required.why_not_automated: This is a live shared secret used by every currently-authenticated Body and route today. An automated rotation with no explicit go-ahead risks locking out production traffic mid-flight if anything holds the old key in a cache or a not-yet-redeployed client. This is exactly the kind of hard-to-reverse, shared-system action that warrants a direct confirmation rather than silent execution.
manual_action_required.mechanism_when_ready: System self-execution already exists for this: generate a new random value, POST /api/v1/railway/env/bulk with the new COMMAND_CENTER_KEY (per CLAUDE.md's System Self-Execution Rule), update local .env to match, confirm the new value is live, then invalidate the old one.

success_criteria: All 4 target files pass their behavior_assertions.

task-authorization-envelope.js's verify() is actually called from general-browser-agent-routes.js, not just exported (grep-provable, per this repo's own 'acceptance must prove reachability, not just existence' rule).
The existing 15 Phase-1 Taloa services and 2 overlay routes continue to pass their own existing tests — this mission adds checks, it must not break what's already wired.
failure_criteria: verify()/issueBodyToken/verifyBodyToken exported but not called from any real route (same BUILT_UNWIRED failure mode already found once in this product's own history).
Any change outside the 4 named target files.
requireKey's existing key-comparison weakened or removed.
escalation: Architect owns implementation-detail questions. Builder executes. Sentry verifies. Adam owns only the manual_action_required key rotation and the founder-usability verdict.

risk_register.risk: This mission touches the exact route (general-browser-agent-routes.js) that gates payment/vault authority.
risk_register.mitigation: GATE0-002's task explicitly requires the existing requireKey gate stay intact and only adds a check on top — reviewed for reachability, not just export, per success_criteria.

risk_register.risk: Closing Gate 0 might be read as authorization to immediately widen Body authority further.
risk_register.mitigation: This mission's own non_goals explicitly excludes building the ChatGPT adapter. Gate 0 closing unblocks the next blueprint; it does not auto-dispatch it.
